answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 8457 Country: India Title: Plz tell me the meaning of Husaifa, can we put our child name only Husaifa? Question: Asalam walekum, plz tell me the meaning of Husaifa, can we put our child name only Husaifa? Answer ID: 8457 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2006/1592=H/1429) The meaning is not known, but it is name of a great Sahabi (companion of the Prophet peace be upon him), may Allah be pleased with him. Therefore, you can name your child with the same, it is better if it is only Huzaifa. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
